text: especially where water courses flow into the lake. A similar phenomenon has occurred at Lake Madden, along whose shores literally tons of material have been recovered since the 1930s. The kind of indiscriminate collecting that has been practised around Lake Madden, though socially unavoidable, has helped to limit the scientific value of the exposed material. In this context, we feel that, as soon as the level of Lake Gatun is dropped and the widening and extension of small-boat channels contemplated, an archaeological survey be conducted, as it is vital for materials to be located and studied in as pristine a state as possible.
